MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 1

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

6. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 6

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

14. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

15. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 33
   D. 28

17. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

20. Solve for x: x + 3 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 10
   C. 3
   D. 7

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 18
   C. 45
   D. 36

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

25. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 11

26. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

27. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 9

28. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

29. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

30. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
